full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: M is actual calibrated net mass of one complete accepted hardware configuration, including its declared supplied controller/cables/adapter and contained water once; exclude removable packaging and test assets. Collect using cp_release. Q is the sum of unique first-release net masses. Do not derive M from catalogue gross weight, rated power, secondary properties or component estimates.

Preserve each row native property/group/reference unit. kg, MJ, kWh, m3 and item are not interchangeable. Convert real rates over measured intervals once; integrated gas/liquid volume is not multiplied by time again. Volume-to-mass requires independent substance/state density. Number of items to Item(s)/item is factor1 only as a physical count; never a guessed item kg or secondary mass coefficient.

Physical V is full observed gross event in the row native unit; no economic share, burden A or B_open+U-B_close substitutes for it. Real burden A is attributed separately once. cp_* collects undivided raw records only; calc_single_quotient alone divides each dimension by manufacturing Q or original Qc for observed service.

calculationRules.rule: Retain raw readings before conversion or attribution. Convert actual kWh to MJ by3.6 once. Integrate actual rates over measured intervals only; never re-integrate a total volume. Each needed density is independently measured for the actual substance/temperature/pressure/phase; no guessed density, piece kg or secondary coefficient.

Q=sum actual calibrated net M kg of uniquely first-released complete conforming hardware configurations. Actual included controller/cable/adapter, installed materials and contained water counted once; removable packaging excluded. Closing releasedFG is already included, not additional output.

For each exchange vector A_c=B_open+U-B_close-T_other. B is raw/WIP and unused/unassigned nonWIP stores or service charge only; never releasedFG or service already performed. U is actual new additions; if consumption is already stock-corrected use the equivalent ledger without a second stock deduction. T_other needs real independent other cohort/function and one justified handover, not ordinary rejected/sold waste.

A_H=actual increments+opening unused/unassigned charge-closing unused/unassigned charge-justified other-function handover. Preserve original manufacturing vector once. Service already performed remains even when FG is still in stock; only unused/unassigned charge carries. Original Qc is original first-release kg, not return, current shipment or repaired kg. H is actually observed, future service unknown.

q=N/D once for each separate result dimension. Physical N=complete actual gross leg V in row native unit, never A, stock consumption or economic/service share. Burden N=A_c or A_H independently. Manufacturing D=Q; actual original-cohort service and related gross legs D=original Qc with observed H. finished_console is1 kg reference. Q0 retains all raw loads and no unit result. Cards and aggregation only reference this same result; no second division, stock correction, provider purchase or credit from gross disclosure.

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out. O and C are complete actual wet opening/closing empty, attached-WIP, attached-FG and reusable stocks. P/I/ER are disjoint whole-article inward legs; S is gross outward shipment, EO external return sent, W the actual whole wet discard. ER is external return received. J_in/J_out are independently measured non-water repair, replacement, residue or other material transfers across this packaging-pool boundary not already in those whole-article legs. H2O_in/H2O_out are independently measured actual water transfers across this pool boundary not already embodied in those legs; include natural adsorption/desorption without any repair. Split wet added/removed material into disjoint non-water J and H2O; no prescribed composition or density. Full wet W includes substrate/retained residues/water once, so its nested components are not additional J_out or H2O_out unless physically separated before the boundary. Matched internal pool transfers cancel on foreground consolidation and create no extra purchase, service or Q. P/I whole article counted once; internal reuse/attachment cancels. S is gross physical shipment, not net product Q. X only deduplicates another same-side incoming/outgoing term; new retained material/water influx and full wet closing stock both remain. Independently measured originW is not added to one mixed external waste outlet.

Manufacture: opening raw/WIP/unassigned physical stocks+disjoint real incoming material and water=closing same stocks+first-release hardware Q+actual waste/species outputs. FG/service: openingFG+internal Q handoff+external gross returns+disjoint new parts/water=closingFG/repairWIP+gross external dispatch/returns+actual waste/species. Reconcile packaging/assets and in-place fluids separately, then cancel matched internal pairs on consolidation. Q and closing releasedFG are not two production outputs; real retained influx is never cancelled by closing stock. Every actual packaging pool uses the complete disjoint J_in/J_out and H2O_in/H2O_out wet balance in calc_pack; duplicate observations cannot remove C or real increments.

Independently reconcile full wet mass and relevant elemental balances from evidenced real species and states; free, formulation-carrier, adsorbed, reaction and structural water are distinct when actually present. Never fit two unknowns to one residual, infer a molecule from VOC/COD/PM/total carbon/boron, or count whole articles plus their chemical children. Actual gas/heat carrier mass and energy service are distinct with one supply owner; actual returned heat-carrier Product state, phase/T/P/enthalpy and supplier water/energy convention must be declared without inventing steam/boiler circuits.

measurementRules.rule: M为一个完整验收硬件配置的实际经校准净质量，含声明随附控制器/线缆/适配器和内含水一次；不含可移除包装及测试资产。采用cp_release采集，Q为唯一首次放行净质量之和。不由商品毛重、额定功率、次级属性或元件估计推导M。
保留逐行原生属性/组/参考单位，kg、MJ、kWh、m3与item不互换。真实速率只按实测区间积分一次，已积分气液体积不再乘时间。体积转质量须该物质状态的独立密度。Number of items到Item(s)/item仅物理件数因子1，绝非猜测单件kg或次级质量系数。
实物V为本行原生单位完整观测毛事件；不得以经济份额、负荷A或B_open+U-B_close替代。真实负荷A另维度归属一次。cp_*仅采未除原始记录，只有calc_single_quotient按制造Q或已观测服务原Qc对各维度除一次。

calculationRules.rule: 转换归属前保留原数，实际kWh乘3.6转MJ一次。仅对真实速率按实测区间积分，不重复积分总体积。需要的密度按真实物质/温度/压力/相态独立测，不猜密度/单件kg或用次级系数。
Q=sum唯一首次放行完整合格硬件配置的实际经校准净M kg。真实随附控制器/线缆/适配器、已装材料及内含水计一次，不含可移除包装。期末已放行FG已计入，不是额外产量。
逐交换向量A_c=B_open+U-B_close-T_other。B仅原料/WIP及未用未分配非WIP库存或服务预付；绝非已放行FG或已执行服务。U为实际新增；已作库存修正的消耗采用等价账不二扣库存。T_other须真实独立其他批次/功能及一次正当移交，普通被拒/售出废物不满足。
A_H=真实增量+期初未用未分配预付-期末未用未分配预付-正当其他功能移交。原制造向量继承一次；即使FG留库，已执行服务也保留，只有未用未分配预付结转。原Qc是原首次放行kg，不是退回、本期发运或修复kg；H是实际已观测，未来服务未知。
每个独立结果维度只执行一次q=N/D。实物N=行原生单位完整真实毛腿V，绝非A、库存消耗或经济/服务份额。负荷N独立采用A_c或A_H。制造D=Q；实际原批次服务及相关毛腿D=原Qc并保留观测H。finished_console为1 kg参考。Q0保留全部原负荷且无单位结果。卡及聚合只引用该同一次结果，不再除、修库存，毛流披露不产生供方采购或信用。

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out。O、C 为真实完整湿态期初期末空、附在制、附成品及周转库存。P/I/ER 是互斥整物品入向；S 为毛发运，EO 为向外返还，W 为真实整湿废弃物；ER 为收到外部返还。J_in/J_out 是独立实测、跨本包装池且尚未包含于上述整物品方向的非水修理、替换、残留或其他材料转移。H2O_in/H2O_out 是独立实测、跨本池且尚未内含于上述方向的真实水转移，含没有任何修理的自然吸解湿。新增或移除湿材料拆为互斥非水 J 与 H2O，不预设组成或密度。完整湿态 W 已含基材、留存残余及水一次；除非边界前真实分离，其嵌套组分不再列 J_out 或 H2O_out。已配对内部池转移在前景合并时抵消，不新增采购、服务或 Q。P/I整件计一次；内部复用/附着抵消。S为实物发运毛量，非净产品Q。X只去重同侧另一入/出流项；新增留存料/水入流及完整期末湿库存同时保留。独立测originW不另加于单一混合废物外部出口。

制造：期初原料/WIP/未分配实物库存+不重叠真实材料水入流=同类期末库存+首次放行硬件Q+真实废物/物种输出。FG/服务：期初FG+内部Q交接+外部退回毛量+不重叠新件/水=期末FG/维修WIP+外部发运/退回毛量+实际废物/物种。包装/资产及在装流体另平衡，合并时匹配内部对抵消。Q及期末已放行FG不是两项产量，真实留存入流不被期末库存消掉。 每个真实包装池均采用 calc_pack 含互斥 J_in/J_out 和 H2O_in/H2O_out 的完整湿质量等式；重复观测不能冲 C 或真实增量。
以证实真实物种状态独立核平全湿质量及相关元素；真实存在的游离、制剂载水、吸附、反应及结构水分别。不得以一个残差拟两个未知、由VOC/COD/PM/总碳/硼推分子、或整件与化学子项叠加。真实气体/载热质量与能量服务分开且一个供方；真实返还载热Product须声明状态、相态/T/P/焓及供方水能约定，不虚构蒸汽/锅炉回路。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 取得真实图纸/BOM、模块门及全部供方范围桥，确认兼容接口及完整首次整机测试；不假定SKU或供货范围。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 图纸；收货；验收计划；实际固件/测试/放行日志

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留原数、单位、校准、速率/区间、不确定性及全部失败/Q0/空转/清理/返工期；实际缺数保留为完整性发现。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原始称重/仪表及失败运行记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留每流实物库存及继承交换向量；制造、FG/服务、包装、资产、流体及混合废物来源分别核平；即使留存也保留完整真实入流。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 签署衡算及唯一事件/所有者桥

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 核查完整原生命名/别名/备注/CAS、全部等级/形态/路线/地域/介质/type限制及每条精确属性/组/参考单位链。普通辅助身份/供方未决明确披露，缺相容完整产品参考则不得使用。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原生身份及逐行限制；供方匹配

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 科学/翻译审查与工程检查分开；历史制造和现代维修/环境报告不是同一工厂清单。披露全部未知、观测H、软件范围、上游代理及未代表生命周期阶段。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 来源范围矩阵及数据集披露
